description: Prospective holdout questions authored from printed statement cells and same-accession SEC XBRL facts before any resolver ran on these filings. Every question is accession-scoped; the cohort contains no as-of multi-filing question.
period_convention: period is the calendar year of the fiscal period end, not the issuer's fiscal-year label; every question text states the period end date.
reviewer: single author, two independent authorities per cell

review.method: printed statement cell read with an independent table dumper; corroborated by the SEC XBRL fact filed with the same accession
